scene: one child about seven years old stands alone on a ground line beside a small bench, front view, whole figure. The body is small and the head is large for it, the face is smooth and round, the hair is short and full. A small ball lies at the feet.
must: a small child with a smooth round face and a ball at the feet.
avoid: a bent old person with thin hair and a walking stick (oud-mensen); a small adult beside a big adult (klein); a baby lying in a cot (not the card); a child asleep on the bench (not the card).
contrast: Pair with oud-mensen. The only difference is age: a small child with a smooth face and a ball here, a bent man with thin hair and a stick there.
alt: Een klein kind met kort haar staat naast een bankje; aan zijn voeten ligt een bal.

scene: one elderly man stands alone on a ground line beside a small bench, front view, whole figure. The back is slightly bent, the hair is drawn as a few thin sparse strokes, the face has clear wrinkle lines and the hands lean on a walking stick.
must: a bent man with a wrinkled face, sparse hair and a walking stick.
avoid: a small child with a ball (jong); a tired adult yawning on the bench (moe); a tall adult standing straight (groot); an old chair or old house (oud-spullen).
contrast: Pair with jong. The only difference is age: a bent person with wrinkles and a stick here, a small child with a smooth face and a ball there.
alt: Een gebogen man met dun haar en rimpels steunt op een wandelstok naast een bankje.

scene: one plain drinking glass stands on a bare table, side view, with water drawn right up to the rim and a small wave line on the surface. A small jug with a spout stands beside it, tilted slightly back, as the reference object.
must: a glass with the water line right at the rim.
avoid: a glass with no water in it (leeg); a glass with water to the middle only (half); a glass overflowing with drops on the table (not the card); a tall thin vase (hoog).
contrast: Pair with leeg. The only difference is the amount in the glass: water to the rim here, nothing inside there.
example_nl: Het glas op tafel is vol.
example_en: The glass on the table is full.
alt: Een glas op een tafel staat tot de rand toe met water gevuld naast een klein kannetje.

scene: one plain drinking glass stands on a bare table, side view, with nothing inside and the thin inner walls clearly visible down to the base. A small jug with a spout stands beside it as the reference object, tilted slightly back.
must: a glass with the inside clear all the way to the base.
avoid: a glass with water to the rim (vol); a glass half filled (half); a glass lying on its side (not the card); a broken glass (kapot).
contrast: Pair with vol. The only difference is the amount in the glass: nothing inside here, water to the rim there.
alt: Een glas staat op een tafel met niets erin; ernaast staat een klein kannetje.

scene: one adult stands at the left, side view, whole figure, looking up with the head tilted back. At the right a plain wall rises far above the head, with its top edge drawn near the top of the picture. A small bird sits on top.
must: a wall whose top is far above the person's head.
avoid: a low wall at the height of the knees (laag); a thin tall pole (lang); a person standing on a stool (not the card); a deep hole (diep).
contrast: Pair with laag. The only difference is the wall height: far above the head here, below the knees there.
alt: Een volwassene kijkt naar boven naar een muur die ver boven haar hoofd uitsteekt; bovenop zit een vogel.

scene: one adult stands at the left, side view, whole figure, looking down with the head bent. At the right a plain wall reaches only to the knees, with its top edge drawn near the ground line. A small bird sits on top.
must: a wall whose top is below the person's knees.
avoid: a wall far above the head (hoog); a short person next to a normal wall (klein); a deep ditch (diep); a person lying on the ground (not the card).
contrast: Pair with hoog. The only difference is the wall height: below the knees here, far above the head there.
alt: Een volwassene kijkt naar beneden naar een muur die slechts tot de knieën reikt; bovenop zit een vogel.

scene: one plain cup stands on a bare table, side view, with five tall bold steam lines curling up from it. The forearm and hand from the right pull back quickly from the cup with fingers spread, and a small spoon rests on the table.
must: a cup with five tall steam lines and a hand pulling away.
avoid: a cup with one short steam line (warm); a cup with ice cubes and frost marks (koud); a flame or fire (not the card); a sun with rays (not the card).
contrast: Pair with warm and koud. The only difference is the heat signs: five tall steam lines and a hand pulling away here, one gentle line there, and ice cubes there.
alt: Uit een kopje stijgen vijf dikke stoomlijnen op en een hand trekt zich snel terug.

scene: one plain cup stands on a bare table, side view, with one short gentle steam line rising from it. The forearm and hand from the right rest curled round the cup, relaxed, and a small spoon lies on the table.
must: a cup with one short steam line and a relaxed hand around it.
avoid: a cup with five tall steam lines and a hand pulling away (heet); a cup with ice cubes and frost marks (koud); a person in a thick coat (koud); a sun in the sky (not the card).
contrast: Pair with heet and koud. The only difference is the heat signs: one short line and a relaxed hand here, many tall lines and a hand pulling away, or ice there.
example_en: My tea is nice and warm.
alt: Een hand houdt rustig een kopje vast waaruit een kort slingerend lijntje opstijgt.

scene: one plain cup stands on a bare table, side view, with three ice cubes visible inside and small frost marks drawn on the outside wall. The forearm and hand from the right touch the cup with one finger, short shiver marks drawn beside the finger, and a small spoon lies on the table.
must: a cup with ice cubes and frost marks, and shiver marks at the finger.
avoid: a cup with five tall steam lines (heet); a cup with one gentle steam line (warm); a snowman (not the card); a person wearing a scarf only (not the card).
contrast: Pair with heet and warm. The only difference is the temperature signs: ice cubes and frost here, steam lines there.
example_nl: De melk in de koelkast is koud.
example_en: The milk in the fridge is cold.
alt: Een kopje met ijsblokjes en rijp aan de buitenkant staat op tafel; een vinger raakt het aan.

scene: one adult stands on a ground line, side view, whole figure, carrying one plain cardboard box in both arms. The knees are bent, the back is curved, the face is strained and a few sweat drops fly from the forehead. Nothing is drawn above the box.
must: a person bent under a box with strained face and bent knees.
avoid: a person holding the same box easily in one hand (licht-gewicht); a thin-armed man unable to lift a small stool (zwak); a person pushing a box on the floor (duwen); a very large box with an easy stance (groot).
contrast: Pair with licht-gewicht. The only difference is the weight of the box: bent knees and a strained face here, straight body and a relaxed face there.
alt: Een volwassene draagt met gebogen knieën een doos en er vliegen zweetdruppels van het voorhoofd.

scene: one adult stands on a ground line, side view, whole figure, holding one plain cardboard box in one hand at chest height with a straight back and straight legs. The face is relaxed and smiling, and a small feather floats above the box.
must: a straight person holding a box in one hand with a relaxed face.
avoid: a person bent under a box (zwaar); a box floating by itself (not the card); a bright room with rays through the window (licht-kamer); a thin person with a thin box (dun).
contrast: Pair with zwaar. The only difference is the weight of the box: straight body and one hand here, bent knees and strain there.
alt: Een volwassene houdt met één hand een doos omhoog en staat helemaal recht; boven de doos zweeft een veertje.

scene: one plain wooden chair seen from the side, with a flat plank seat. A small cat sits on the seat with straight legs and a stiff back, the plank unchanged by its weight. Three short straight lines mark the edge of the seat.
must: a flat plank seat that does not change shape under the cat.
avoid: a thick rounded cushion with a dent (zacht); a loud bang with sound lines (hard-geluid); a cat asleep on a chair (not the card); a very heavy stone (zwaar).
contrast: Pair with zacht. The only difference is the seat: a flat plank with no dent here, a thick cushion with a deep dent there.
alt: Een kat zit op een vlakke houten zitting die niet inzakt.

scene: one plain chair seen from the side, with a thick rounded cushion on the seat. A small cat sits on the cushion, and the cushion has a clear round dent under the cat with soft curved folds around it.
must: a thick cushion with a deep dent under the cat.
avoid: a flat plank seat with no dent (hard); a quiet room with a closed door (stil); a cat with fluffy fur only (not the card); a pillow on a bed (not the card).
contrast: Pair with hard. The only difference is the seat: a thick cushion with a dent here, a flat plank with no dent there.
example_en: My bed is nice and soft.
alt: Een kat zit op een dik kussen dat diep inzakt met ronde plooien eromheen.

scene: one adult man stands on a ground line, side view, whole figure, with thick bulging upper arms, holding one small plain wooden stool high above his head in one hand. The face is calm and the other arm hangs loose. The stool is small and obviously light, and the wall behind is plain.
must: a thick-armed man holding a small stool overhead in one hand.
avoid: a thin-armed man who cannot lift the stool (zwak); a person bent under a heavy box (zwaar); a person with a hammer (hard); a person flexing in front of a mirror (not the card).
contrast: Pair with zwak. The only difference is the strength: thick arms and the stool high in one hand here, thin arms and the stool still on the ground there.
alt: Een man met dikke armen houdt met één hand een krukje hoog boven zijn hoofd.

scene: one adult man stands on a ground line, side view, whole figure, with thin upper arms, bending over one small plain wooden stool with both hands on its seat. The stool stays on the ground, short shake marks show at the arms and the face is strained. The stool is small and obviously light, and the wall behind is plain.
must: a thin-armed man who cannot raise a small light stool.
avoid: a thick-armed man holding the stool overhead (sterk); a person bent under a big heavy box (zwaar); a person asleep on the ground (moe); a person with a bandage (ziek).
contrast: Pair with sterk. The only difference is the strength: thin arms and the stool still on the ground here, thick arms and the stool high in one hand there.
example_nl: Mijn oma is een beetje zwak.
example_en: My grandmother is a bit weak.
alt: Een man met dunne armen probeert een klein krukje op te tillen, maar het blijft op de grond staan.

scene: a white outlined face with a wide smile curving up, brows raised and relaxed, round open eyes with small crinkle lines at their corners, and cheeks lifted. A few small star marks float beside the head. Shoulders are relaxed.
must: a wide upward smile with raised brows.
avoid: a face with the mouth turned down and a tear (verdrietig); a face with brows pulled down and a tight mouth (boos); a face with an open round mouth (verbaasd); a laughing face with its head thrown back (not the card).
contrast: Pair with verdrietig and boos. The only difference is the face: an upward smile and raised brows here, a downturned mouth and a tear, or pulled-down brows there.
example_nl: Ik ben blij met mijn cadeau.
example_en: I am happy with my present.
alt: Een gezicht met een brede lach, opgetrokken wenkbrauwen en kleine sterretjes naast het hoofd.

scene: a white outlined face with the mouth curved down, the inner ends of the brows lifted and drawn together, eyes cast down and one large tear running down a cheek. The shoulders are slumped. A small cloud floats over the head.
must: a downturned mouth, lifted inner brows and a tear on the cheek.
avoid: a face with a wide smile (blij); a face with brows pulled down and gritted teeth (boos); a face with closed eyes and snore marks (slaperig); a face with a bandage (ziek).
contrast: Pair with blij and boos. The only difference is the face: a downturned mouth and a tear here, a smile there, and flat angry brows there.
example_nl: Het meisje is vandaag erg verdrietig.
example_en: The girl is very sad today.
alt: Een gezicht met een neerwaartse mond, schuine wenkbrauwen en een grote traan op de wang.

scene: a white outlined face with the brows pulled down and drawn together into a sharp V, narrowed eyes, a tight straight mouth with the teeth showing, and two small steam lines at the sides of the head. The shoulders are raised and stiff.
must: brows pulled into a sharp V over narrowed eyes.
avoid: a face with a wide smile (blij); a face with a downturned mouth and a tear (verdrietig); a face with eyes wide and a round mouth (bang); a face with a shout and sound lines (luid).
contrast: Pair with blij and verdrietig. The only difference is the face: a V of brows and a tight mouth here, a smile or a tear there.
example_nl: De man is boos op de hond.
example_en: The man is angry at the dog.
alt: Een gezicht met scherpe wenkbrauwen, smalle ogen, een strakke mond en stoomlijntjes naast het hoofd.

scene: one adult woman sits on a plain chair at a bare table, front view, upper body only, with a blanket round the shoulders. A thermometer sticks out of the mouth, the eyes are half closed, the brows droop, and a plain cup stands on the table. The thermometer has no numerals or scale marks.
must: a woman with a thermometer in the mouth and a blanket round the shoulders.
avoid: an upright woman with the blanket folded aside (gezond); a person asleep with snore marks (slaperig); a person with a sad face and a tear (verdrietig); a person with a bandaged leg (not the card).
contrast: Pair with gezond. The only difference is the health signs: blanket round the shoulders and thermometer in the mouth here, blanket folded aside, thermometer on the table and an upright back there.
alt: Een vrouw zit aan tafel onder een deken met een thermometer in de mond.

scene: one adult woman sits upright on the same plain chair at a bare table, front view, upper body only, eyes open and a calm smile. The blanket lies folded over the chair back, and the thermometer lies on the table beside a plain cup. The thermometer has no numerals or scale marks.
must: an upright woman with the blanket folded aside and the thermometer on the table.
avoid: a woman under a blanket with a thermometer in the mouth (ziek); a person flexing big arms (sterk); a beaming face with a wide grin (blij); a person running with speed lines (snel).
contrast: Pair with ziek. The only difference is the health signs: upright, the blanket folded aside and the thermometer on the table here, the blanket round the shoulders and the thermometer in the mouth there.
example_nl: Mijn oma is oud, maar gezond.
example_en: My grandmother is old, but healthy.
alt: Een vrouw zit rechtop aan tafel; de deken ligt opgevouwen op de stoel en de thermometer ligt op tafel.

scene: one adult treads water at the left, side view, arms moving at the surface and legs kicking below, the wavy surface line at the chin so only the head shows above it. The bottom is a line far below the feet, and a small fish swims low near it. A plain shore lies at the right.
must: a person treading water with the bottom far below the feet.
avoid: a person standing with the water only round the ankles (ondiep); a tall person standing on land (hoog); a person swimming flat on the surface (zwemmen); a hole in the ground (not the card).
contrast: Pair with ondiep. The only difference is the water: the person treads water with the bottom far below here, stands with the water only round the ankles there.
alt: Een volwassene trappelt in het water; alleen het hoofd steekt erboven uit en de bodem ligt ver onder de voeten.

scene: one adult stands at the left in water, side view, whole body visible, with the wavy surface line only around the ankles and the bottom just below the feet. A small pebble and a small fish lie close to the bottom.
must: water reaching only the ankles with the bottom just below the feet.
avoid: a person treading water with the bottom far below (diep); a puddle on a road (not the card); a person wading with the water at the knees (not the card); a dry riverbed (leeg).
contrast: Pair with diep. The only difference is the water: the person stands with the water only round the ankles here, treads water with the bottom far below there.
alt: Een volwassene staat met de hele romp boven het water; de golven raken alleen de enkels.

scene: one adult stands at the left on a ground line, side view, whole figure, and a plain house with a door stands just a few steps away at the right, large in the picture. A short dotted line with three footprints joins the person's feet to the door.
must: a house just a few footprints away from the person.
avoid: a tiny house far away on the horizon (ver); a person standing in the doorway (not the card); a big house with the person beside it (groot); a long road with many footprints (lang).
contrast: Pair with ver. The only difference is the gap: three footprints to a large house here, a long empty road to a tiny house there.
alt: Een volwassene staat links en een huis met een deur staat op drie stappen afstand.

scene: one adult stands at the left on a ground line, side view, whole figure, and a tiny plain house with a door stands at the far right near the horizon. A long dotted line with many footprints stretches across the empty ground between them.
must: a tiny house at the end of a long dotted line of footprints.
avoid: a large house just a few footprints away (dichtbij); a long road with a car (not the card); a small house standing close by (klein); a tall building (hoog).
contrast: Pair with dichtbij. The only difference is the gap: a long empty road to a tiny house here, three footprints to a large house there.
example_nl: Mijn werk is ver van huis.
example_en: My work is far from home.
alt: Een volwassene staat links en rechts aan de horizon staat een klein huisje achter een lange rij voetsporen.
